titre: Synthesis test n°1 — English (4th year primary, first year)

exercices.enonce:
Greetings. Complete with the words in the box: Hello — name — you — fine.
1) - .......... ! Good morning.
2) - What is your ..........? - My name is Ali.
3) - How are ..........?
4) - I am .........., thank you.

Numbers.
1) Write the number: (2 points)
seven = ....   ten = ....
2) Write in letters: (2 points)
3 = ..........   6 = ..........   9 = ..........

Colours.
1) Complete the colour: (2 points)
The sky is b .... u e.   Grass is g r .... .... n.
2) Circle the colour words: (2 points)
red — cat — yellow — book — green.

Classroom objects.
1) True or False: (2 points)
- A pen is a classroom object. ....
- A dog is a classroom object. ....
2) Complete: (2 points)
I write with a p .... n.   I read a b .... .... k.

Numbers 11-20.
1) Write the number: (2 points)
eleven = ....   fifteen = ....
2) Write in letters: (2 points)
12 = ..........   20 = ..........
